panels.mapping: matrix.csv supplies the displayed settings, success counts, time and score. policy_results.csv supplies all 130 individual nominal/transfer evaluations; Reach (x/5) counts target captures among five frozen policies per method. The raw test identifier 0 is displayed as Original in the manuscript. The Agent header groups Reach, t_champ and s_champ; DRL reports Reach. The champ subscript identifies SEAS_1, the same retained EvE champion (archival method name SEAS) across all tests; t_champ and s_champ display the raw t_end and s fields, respectively.
